### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 4/10" aria-label="Importance 4 of 10">4</span> Lam Research Opens 470,000-Square-Foot Warehouse in Livermore to Support AI Semiconductor Demand
Lam Research, a semiconductor equipment manufacturer, has opened a new 470,000-square-foot facility in Livermore, California, its largest U.S. warehouse, expected to employ over 240 workers by 2027 to meet rising demand for AI and semiconductor technology.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>470,000-square-foot facility at 710 Atlantis Street in Livermore</li>
<li>Expected to employ more than 240 workers by 2027</li>
<li>Largest warehouse in the U.S. for Fremont-based Lam Research</li>
<li>Designed to support growing semiconductor demand driven by AI and next-generation technologies</li>
</ul>
